name: M8.AntipodalFamily.literal_polynomial
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], 8 ≤ N → Even N → M7.Supports.polynomial (M8.AntipodalFamily.support N) = M8.AntipodalFamily.polynomial N

noncomputable def support (N : ℕ) : Finset (ZMod N) := {0,1,((N/2 : ℕ) : ZMod N),((N/2+1 : ℕ) : ZMod N)}
